bhajans.title: Ganesha Sharanam
bhajans.meaning: I take refuge in Lord Ganesha, remover of obstacles.
bhajans.notes: Traditional opening bhajan. Begin slowly, double the tempo on the repeat.
bhajans.lyrics:
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
Gam Gam Ganapathi Sharanam Ganesha
Gam Gam Ganapathi Sharanam Ganesha
Jai Ganesha Jai Jai Gananatha

bhajans.title: Sathya Sai Ram Om Sai Ram
bhajans.meaning: Chanting the name of Sai Ram, embodiment of truth.
bhajans.notes: A centre favourite. Invite the congregation to clap on the fast repeat.
bhajans.lyrics:
Om Sai Ram Om Sai Ram
Sathya Sai Ram Om Sai Ram
Om Sai Ram Om Sai Ram
Parthi Vihari Om Sai Ram
Prema Swaroopa Om Sai Ram

bhajans.title: Subrahmanyam Subrahmanyam
bhajans.meaning: Salutations to Lord Subrahmanya, the six-faced divine general.
bhajans.notes: Builds quickly. Watch the lead singer for the tempo change.
bhajans.lyrics:
Subrahmanyam Subrahmanyam
Shanmukhanatha Subrahmanyam
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Subrahmanyam
Hara Hara Hara Hara Subrahmanyam

bhajans.title: He Shiva Shankara Namami Shankara
bhajans.meaning: O Shiva, Shankara, I bow to you, bestower of auspiciousness.
bhajans.notes: Meditative. Keep the harmonium soft under the first verse.
bhajans.lyrics:
He Shiva Shankara Namami Shankara
Shiva Shankara Shambho
He Girijapathi Bhavani Shankara
Shiva Shankara Shambho

bhajans.title: Rama Rama Rama Sita
bhajans.meaning: Chanting the names of Rama and Sita together.
bhajans.lyrics:
Rama Rama Rama Sita
Rama Nama Bhajare
Krishna Krishna Krishna Radha
Krishna Nama Bhajare

bhajans.title: Govinda Krishna Jai
bhajans.meaning: Victory to Govinda, victory to Krishna.
bhajans.notes: Good for children’s sessions. Simple call and response.
bhajans.lyrics:
Govinda Krishna Jai
Gopala Krishna Jai
Gopala Bala Bala Radha
Krishna Jai
Govinda Krishna Jai
Gopala Krishna Jai

bhajans.title: Om Namah Shivaya
bhajans.meaning: Salutations to Shiva, the five-syllable mantra.
bhajans.notes: Often used to close the session before aarti.
bhajans.lyrics:
Om Namah Shivaya
Om Namah Shivaya
Om Namah Shivaya
Shivaya Namah Om
Hara Hara Hara Hara Namah Shivaya

bhajans.title: Allah Ho Akbar
bhajans.meaning: God is great. A bhajan honouring the unity of all faiths.
bhajans.notes: Sung during interfaith programs and Sarva Dharma celebrations.
bhajans.lyrics:
Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar
La Ilaha Illallah
Maula Salim Ala Ho Akbar
La Ilaha Illallah

bhajans.title: Love Is My Form
bhajans.meaning: A song of Baba’s message in English.
bhajans.notes: English bhajan. Often sung at public programs for newcomers.
bhajans.lyrics:
Love is my form, Truth is my breath
Bliss is my food
My life is my message
Expansion is my life
No season for love, No reason for love
No birth, no death

bhajans.title: Jai Jai Jai Gananayaka
bhajans.meaning: Victory to the leader of the ganas, Lord Ganesha.
bhajans.lyrics:
Jai Jai Jai Gananayaka
Jai Jai Vighna Vinashaka
Jai Shubhakara Jai Mangala Kara
Jai Jai Vidya Buddhi Pradayaka

bhajans.title: Narayana Hari
bhajans.lyrics:
Narayana Hari Om
Hari Om Hari Om

signupForms.title: Sunday Devotional Singing (July 19)
signupForms.description: Please select your offerings for the upcoming Sunday session. Refer to the Bhajan Library for lyrics and practice recordings. Only Ganesha, Shiva, Krishna, and Sai bhajans are allowed.

signupForms.title: Guru Purnima Special Devotional Program
signupForms.description: Select one offering for the Guru Purnima program. Limit to Guru, Sai, and Sarva Dharma categories. Sign-ups close on July 25.
